assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's single curated item, reviewed-dedicated-analysis: the canonical V2 character reconstruction model MHA_SP2_AMAJIKI_TAMAKI_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the Japanese main manga V01-V42 with the source-labeled Ultra Archive, Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its AT-SUP-01 to AT-SUP-03 sections admit. The MHA character modeling schema was consulted for method only; the readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit and the V14-V16 deep readings are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. The model's strong readiness label and its retrospective holdout probe are inputs, not conclusions. No original manga page, anime adaptation, V1 material or other character's model is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Amajiki Tamaki from his V14 classroom introduction (V14:p073-078) through V15-V16 field work under Fat Gum and the solo bottleneck fight (V15:p072-084, V16:p047-083), the V36 Big Three engagement with its support-acceptance reflection (V36:p150-185, logical pages, p180 excluded as guest illustration) and the V42 adult Fat Gum sidekick epilogue (V42:p149-153), kept as separable snapshots (inhibited public introduction, practiced field work, V36 regulation update, adult professional). No atom covers V17-V35, and the supplement's food and employment claims are endpoint or author claims, not enacted scenes.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states conflicting priorities (fulfill a useful protective responsibility, keep trusted peers able to act, meet the confidence placed in him, avoid public failure or scrutiny), a feared self (disappointing people who see more in him than he can affirm), an ideal self defined by his own capability rather than Mirio's style, and context-dependent attention allocation (exposure under evaluation, a coordination node under an operational problem). Each rests on six located atoms AT01-AT06 across V14-V42 at high confidence. Not B: one compact artifact with six atoms and one retrospective probe, and the model leaves adult and private breadth and response outside sampled support relations OPEN. Not D: the policy is operational and yields located conditional predictions with a stated context transition.

Snapshots are located in story-present: inhibited public introduction (AT01), field work with external capability loss and a solo bottleneck fight (AT02-AT03), the V36 update from experiencing belief as crushing to receiving it as strength (AT05, V36:p181) and adult persistence of self-questioning alongside professional standing (AT06). The model forbids anxiety-free maturation. Not B: each transition rests on one atom, V17-V35 has no atom, and the probe rates the emotional trajectory only partial. Not D: change is located across the whole series.

Attested features are few: 俺, hesitant and self-questioning ordinary delivery, unexpectedly categorical mission declarations (AT03), more exposed gratitude in V36, and adult hesitant self-evaluation with a comic wish to hide (AT06). The model warns against encoding stammering into every line and states exact adult intimate voice is unestablished. These answer bounded canon questions about register only; the discovery row does not enroll SPEECH.

Ordinary texture is classroom inhibition (AT01), an adult comic retreat after a hasty inference (AT06) and the author comment that childhood fear of foods became curiosity (AT-SUP-02), which the model says does not identify preferences or end anxiety. The model states broader private routine, romance and independent family conflict remain low-confidence or unknown.

A six-row partner table (Mirio, Nejire, Fat Gum and Kirishima, Hassaikai opponents, Ochako and adult collaborators, an unfamiliar audience) gives a one-sentence conditional difference for each, and the reciprocal Mirio relation is located (AT04) against a one-way-dependence reading; the supplement adds that warm encouragement can also pressure or frighten him (AT-SUP-01). Not C: deltas are sketched, most partners rest on one scene, and relationships outside sampled support relations are OPEN.

The wish to escape a classroom audience (AT01), belief experienced as crushing weight and its V36 reinterpretation as received strength (V36:p181, the one located reflective window) and adult self-doubt (AT06) are partly located and partly inferred. Not C: a single explicit reflective window, and the model states the source does not establish a permanent change in anxiety.

Conflict is his most-evidenced mode with a stated policy: identify the team's limiting problem, state the role he can perform, use technical flexibility, acknowledge support, act under uncertainty. It is located in a solo three-opponent bottleneck fight with Manifest adaptation and recognition of opponents' coordination (AT03) and in the V36 bounded protective task with combined consumed capacities and Nejire's energy (AT05), with the probe supporting action and motive. Not B: two major engagements, and the profile and move caption disagree about the V36 attack's efficacy. Not D: the policy is explicit and located with conditional predictions.

The normative content is bounded: he recognizes opponents' bonds while opposing their actions and admits lacking their circumstances (AT03), and takes a bottleneck alone to serve the rescue line rather than from preference for isolation. Not C: no dilemma he weighs is analyzed, and the model offers no explicit decision doctrine for moral conflict; the discovery row does not enroll ETHICS.

The only located play is the adult comic wish to dig a hiding hole after a hasty inference (AT06), which the model reads as comic self-criticism; Mirio's potato reframe in AT01 is Mirio's humor, not his. Not D: no recurrent practice of his own is modeled.

The project's analytical corpus is complete for V01-V42 and the three admitted supplements, and the six atoms span V14-V42 with page locators; the V36 decisive logical pages and V42 are stated to be checked, with the V36 page convention and the p180 exclusion explicit. No atom covers V17-V35, the model does not itemize every appearance, and supplements are profile and author claims.

Affirmative limits are located: the model REJECTs anxiety-free maturation and automatic victory and REVISEs one-way dependence and belief as only burden; he admits not knowing opponents' histories (AT03); the V36 attack depends on allies buying time and its efficacy is contested between profile and caption (AT-SUP-03); a ranking above Mirio is rumor; his concern for Ochako is corrected by her own account (AT06); the probe's emotional-trajectory axis is partial. Not B: the limits rest on a few windows in one artifact.

Snapshots are named by volume and logical page, with the V36 spread convention stated and a guest illustration excluded; the model forbids projecting relaxed adult charisma from adult status and forbids treating the V36 update as a permanent cure. In-world dates are not given and V17-V35 is unsampled.

scenario_readiness.note: The model states that generated dialogue would be an illustrative prediction, never an attributed quotation, warns against encoding stammering into every line, and states exact adult intimate voice is unestablished. Lines beyond the attested forms would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Tamaki's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named snapshot: V14 public introduction, V15-V16 field work, V36 Big Three engagement or V42 adult sidekick, never blended; no V17-V35 behavior is invented.
The situation is an operational task within a trusted team where a bounded role can help, as the decision policy requires; the context transition is predicted before tone.
The interlocutor is Mirio, Nejire, Fat Gum, Kirishima, Ochako or an opponent handled as the partner table gives, with no invented private relationship.
Manifest uses only consumed inputs and allied support the scene supplies, and no outcome is guaranteed by confidence or visual scale.

Output is a behavioral description with high-confidence behavior, plausible alternatives and flip conditions, abstaining on the model's OPEN items of adult and private breadth and response outside sampled support relations; no quoted dialogue is produced as canon and no readiness is inherited from the strong label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named snapshot: V14 inhibited introduction, V15-V16 practiced field work, V36 Big Three engagement, or V42 adult Fat Gum sidekick, stated explicitly.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Mirio as reciprocal friend, Nejire as Big Three teammate, Fat Gum or Kirishima as trusted professionals, Ochako as an adult collaborator, or opponents in a protective engagement.
setting_constraints: Hero field work, internship, rescue or team combat with a bounded role for him
Manifest depends on consumed inputs, combination and timing
Others' confidence is evidence of their evaluation, not of a guaranteed win
No public ceremonial, family, romance or unrelated private-life setting

scenario_readiness.note: The operational decision policy and the stated late-school prediction (a feasibility question followed by a precise contribution, high confidence within trusted teams) support narrow novel team-operational decisions. The one formal probe is retrospective and nonblind with a partial emotional axis, so readiness is conditional and narrow.

The model affirmatively leaves adult and private breadth and response outside sampled support relations OPEN, states that broader private routine is low-confidence or unknown, and warns that adult status does not justify predicting relaxed sociability in unfamiliar settings; the located ordinary social evidence is classroom inhibition and one adult peer exchange.

The evidence offers one bounded normative stance (recognizing opponents' bonds without claiming their history or forgiving their acts) and a role choice, but no analyzed deliberation or doctrine for moral conflict. This bounds the evidence set, not Tamaki's ethics.
Nothing in the evidence set establishes romantic conduct or its absence. This gap says nothing about the character.

conditions: Hero field work under Fat Gum, internship or Big Three operations within a named snapshot.
Visible inhibition and doubt coexist with competence; neither is deleted.
Independent team-management decisions are not generated, since the model states they lack samples, and continued sidekick work is chosen repayment, not inability to lead.
scenario_readiness.note: His best-evidenced domain is field work and bottleneck responsibility within trusted teams, located in AT02, AT03, AT05 and AT06.

known_limits.statement: The model leaves adult and private breadth and response outside sampled support relations OPEN; broader private routine, romance and independent family conflict remain low-confidence or unknown, and exact adult intimate voice is unestablished.
The V36 reinterpretation of others' belief as strength occurs under extreme pressure; the source does not establish a permanent cure for anxiety, and V42 directly shows continuing self-questioning.

Manifest depends on consumed inputs, combination and timing; it is not unrestricted generation, and the V36 combined attack depended on allies buying time. The profile calls it ineffective while the move caption calls it arm-blowing, a recorded tension.
Independent adult team-management response lacks samples, and continued employment with Fat Gum is chosen repayment; a ranking above Mirio is rumor.
He does not know opponents' full motives or histories; his recognition of their bonds is explicitly bounded (AT03).
Supplement profile facts, editorial summaries and author comments (AT-SUP-01 to AT-SUP-03) constrain reconstruction without becoming enacted manga observations.

The single formal probe AT-V01 is a retrospective chronological evidence holdout by an analyst who had read later manga, not a blind experiment; supported axes are qualitative comparisons and the emotional-trajectory axis is only partial.
No evidence atom covers V17-V35, between the Hassaikai raid and the final war, so his behavior over that interval is not established by this evidence set.

The deep readings, readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit linked from the model are not curated evidence on this subject, so their warrants were not independently rechecked here. Anime performance and any supplement material beyond what the model cites lie outside this evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
